title: Version Chooser + Runbooks: compact insights and rollback scenario wizard
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Overview: Deliver a compact, keyboard-friendly 'Version Chooser' panel inside the Console route editor that surfaces recent performance profiles for each model version, a lightweight side-by-side diff for latency/cost/quality, and an integrated Rollback Scenario Wizard tied to runbooks. The goal is to reduce time-to-pin from exploratory conversations to safe rollout by providing actionable signals (perf snapshot, recent regressions, suggested fallback) and an automated small-run rollback playbook that engineering on-call and product owners can trigger or review before a canary release. This work spans UI surface, API contract for perf profile querying, and a small orchestration flow that captures user's rollback choices as audit events.
acceptance_criteria: Version Chooser panel is reachable from any model route and shows a compact list of available model versions with the latest published performance snapshot (median latency, 95th latency, tokens/sec, cost/token, quality score).

Clicking a version opens a transient comparison view with the current pinned version showing common deltas and a color-coded risk indicator (green/yellow/red) computed from thresholds stored in config.

Rollback Scenario Wizard guides the user through selecting rollback target, expected impact (throughput, latency), and a suggested canary traffic split; pressing Confirm produces a draft rollout object and stores a signed audit event linked to the user.
Runbook links and a short checklist are shown inline and can be opened in a modal; the default runbook is auto-suggested based on the route's observed SLOs.
All UI interactions emit analytics events (version_viewed, compare_started, rollback_draft_created, rollback_confirmed) with required metadata for cost and latency attribution.
API endpoint console/v1/routes/:route_id/versions returns perf_profile snapshots and a small historical series for rendering the sparkline within 300ms median.
User tests with 6 internal engineers show task completion (pin a safe version after perf regression) in under 3 minutes for 5/6 participants.
implementation_notes: Backend: expose perf snapshots API with caching keyed by (model_version, route_id, profile_tag). Add small TTL to keep UI snappy. Frontend: implement VersionChooser component inside RouteEditLayout; reuse MetricsChip components and existing color scheme. Orchestration: create RolloutDraft object persisted in console DB; Wire confirm action to create route rollouts via existing rollout API. Security: ensure audit event contains user id and route id. Keep the flow permission-gated by 'route.rollback' scope.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): feature-flag behind console.experimental.version_chooser for 10% of orgs - 2 weeks
Phase 2 (wider): enable for all internal teams, gather NPS and task completion metrics - 1 week
Phase 3 (GA): remove flag, add documentation and customer-facing runbook templates - 1 week
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: perf profile API latency could degrade console performance -> Mitigation: server-side caching and a 50ms client-side placeholder to avoid blocking render.
Risk: accidental rollouts executed by mistake -> Mitigation: keep Confirm behind an explicit two-step modal and require permission 'route.rollback'.
Risk: profiles out of date -> Mitigation: include 'as_of' timestamp and a refresh action that invalidates cache for that version/route.
